description.value: Kismet Estate Winery is a family-owned estate winery in Oliver, BC — the self-proclaimed 'Wine Capital of Canada' — rooted in the Punjabi-Canadian heritage of the Dhaliwal family, who farm 600 acres of South Okanagan vineyards. The winery pairs its estate wines with Manzil, an on-site restaurant reimagining vibrant Indian cuisine using locally sourced Okanagan ingredients and fresh spices from India. It sits squarely in the heart of the South Okanagan wine-route cycling corridor and offers wine club memberships, vineyard tours, and bookable tasting experiences.
